frameworkSections: 9 specific notions18.6; A1 roles/venues versus A2 production roles
objectives.rationale: The enumerated screen meanings supply concrete scenario contrasts; individual entries distinguish required A1 use from proposed later extensions.

objectives.description: Extended social arrangements, sports techniques and named-game rule systems.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions8.1–8.4; checked A1 versus A2 columns
objectives.rationale: The A1 scenario is choosing an activity/destination and identifying a participant, not negotiating invitations, narrating outings or explaining rules. A2 owns quedar arrangements, hiking/cycling procedures, gym enrolment, named board/card-game systems and sport technique. Current A1-C contains explicit later labels and relevel proposals, not a claim these extended scenarios are covered.

objectives.description: Booking procedures and performance-production details.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions8.2,18.2,18.6; A1 identification versus A2 transaction/production
objectives.rationale: The bounded A1 task names a film, venue, concert, exhibition and admission ticket with shared price/time support. Reserving seats, interpreting a detailed programme, director/crew roles, musical genres, instrumental technique and critical review are A2 or later work. Actual introductory ticket/role exceptions remain explicit per selection.

objectives.description: Interactive media operations, news production and message handling.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions9.1–9.6; A1 channels/objects versus A2 operations and roles
objectives.rationale: A1 identifies channels, documents and simple identifiers. Sending/receiving/responding, connection diagnosis, phone transfer or voicemail, news interviews/reporting, advertising analysis, programme structure, online chat/forum participation and software troubleshooting belong later operational scenarios. Legacy operation verbs have explicit A2 proposals instead of being hidden as omissions.

objectives.description: Artistic production, literary genre explanation and critical interpretation.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions18.1–18.6; A1 concrete identification versus A2 taxonomy/production
objectives.rationale: A1 names a concrete medium/work/venue/performer and gives a short reaction using F/P. Artistic movements, detailed architecture, sculpture technique, painting production, literary analysis and camera operation require later scopes. Existing genre/instrument/production records are individually relevelled or flagged, not blanket-approved by category18.

objectives.description: Reference, questions, quantity, scheduling and elementary preferences.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions8.1–8.4,18.1;2 grammar7,9,12
objectives.rationale: Unresolved shared coverage prerequisite: A1-F supplies pronouns/articles, ser/estar/hay, numbers, clock/date, location, ability and selected questions. A1-P/F supply gustar/querer and D supplies accepting/declining, clarification and simple reactions. For an event price, use A1-F-297 ADV cuánto with costar, not only noun-linked A1-F-037 DET. These generic lexemes are not cloned into C.

objectives.description: Food/transport/contact/building and classroom dependencies.
objectives.rationale: Unresolved cross-cell ownership: H owns restaurant/bar/café choices and buying/payment; T owns travel/tourist facilities, ticket es-sk:a1:304-entrada and distinct physical entrance; W owns book/paper/read/write and hardware; P owns phone-number/email-address phrases and social companions; S owns geographic/religious building reuse. Crosslinked objects share IDs, but each owning objective must close independently.

objectives.description: Per-entry morphology and pronunciation execution requirements.
frameworkSections: 2 grammar1–2,9;3 pronunciation/prosody A1/A2
objectives.rationale: Unresolved authoring/review gate: every selected item needs gender/plural, irregular verb, complement, orthographic and connected-phrase checks. Give special attention to actor/actriz, foto gender, radio regional gender, media/device homographs, guion spelling with variable syllabification, rr/j/ñ, and hiatus in teatro/museo/correo/fotografía. Device es-ES routing and risk-stratified listening remain separate physical QA; text notes alone never close audio review.

selections.sense: time not occupied by work or other obligations
selections.levelRationale: This label lets a beginner identify the part of life in which chosen activities occur.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 scenario extension to the PCIC A2 label; do not extend to time-management argument.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine mass phrase; mi tiempo libre; libre modifies tiempo.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress tiem and li; ie diphthong, no written accent.
uncertainties: PCIC8.1 labels this A2; proposed early scaffold for the approved activity-preference scenario.

selections.sense: organized musical sound as an art or listening activity
selections.levelRationale: Provides the basic object of a listening preference and names an artistic domain.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Introduce the general domain before genres and compositional terminology.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Feminine mass noun; escuchar música generally without article.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Three syllables; written accent marks antepenultimate mú.

selections.sense: a short musical work intended to be sung
selections.levelRationale: A learner needs to distinguish an individual song from music as a whole.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: PCIC8.1 A1 listening context supports introduction although18.2 lists the label in A2.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Feminine; canciones loses written accent; cantar/escuchar una canción.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Final ción stress with io diphthong; c before i theta in es-ES.
uncertainties: Cross-inventory A1/A2 placement requires acceptance of the specific listening object.

selections.sense: an audiovisual film as a work to watch
selections.levelRationale: Names the work chosen for an evening, not merely the venue.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Introduce a film as an object; detailed plot, genre and criticism remain later.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Feminine; películas; ver una película.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Four syllables; stress lí, never initial pe.

selections.sense: a venue where films are shown to an audience
selections.levelRationale: An elementary destination choice needs the cinema venue.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Venue meaning is distinct from film-making as an art or industry.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; cines; ir al cine contracts a+el.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Two syllables; ci theta in reference es-ES, seseo valid.
uncertainties: Separate medium sense proposed later in this batch; do not overwrite venue ID.

selections.sense: a venue for live stage performances
selections.levelRationale: Completes the live-stage alternative to a cinema in an outing choice.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: The building/venue is not automatically the performing-art discipline.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; teatros; ir al teatro.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Three syllables te-a-tro with e-a hiatus; stress a.
uncertainties: Venue/discipline granularity must remain explicit.

selections.sense: a place displaying cultural or scientific collections
selections.levelRationale: A visitor can name a museum as a destination without art-history knowledge.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Introduce the venue; curation and provenance belong later.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; museos; visitar/ir a un museo.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Three syllables mu-se-o; stress se and final eo hiatus.

selections.sense: physical activity organized as sport or exercise
selections.levelRationale: Provides an umbrella term for an elementary activity preference.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Basic participation label, not regulation or competitive institutions.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; hacer deporte, practicar un deporte; deportes for kinds.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress por; three syllables, initial de audible.

selections.sense: association football as a sport
selections.levelRationale: Names a common team-game preference distinct from racket and water activities.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Basic identification only; no team tactics or specialist rules.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; jugar al fútbol; variant futbol has different regional stress.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Written accent marks fút; maintain final l and tb boundary.

selections.sense: the racket sport tennis
selections.levelRationale: Supplies a contrasting individual/pair sport in preference questions.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Sport sense, not regional footwear use.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine invariable label; jugar al tenis.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Penultimate te stress; final s audible.

selections.sense: swimming as an activity or sport
selections.levelRationale: Allows recognition of a swimming class/activity label alongside nadar.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Independent A1 scenario extension from the A1 swimming verb, not proof that every sport noun is A1.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Feminine normally mass; hacer/practicar natación.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Three syllables na-ta-ción; final ción stress and io diphthong; c before i is theta in reference es-ES.
uncertainties: PCIC8.3 foregrounds nadar rather than this noun; confirm introduction of activity-label pair.

selections.sense: rhythmic bodily movement as dancing
selections.levelRationale: Names the activity for a learner who says they like dancing.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Ordinary activity before artistic-school or social-event meanings.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; bailes for kinds; bailar is the corresponding verb.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Two syllables bai-le; ai diphthong and stress bai.
uncertainties: Distinguish ordinary baile from art-focused danza without counting mere stylistic synonyms twice.

selections.sense: an activity with rules undertaken for amusement
selections.levelRationale: Generic game identification enables a beginner to choose a leisure activity.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: No automatic extension to a set of objects, gambling or figurative interaction.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; juegos; jugar a un juego.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress jue with ue diphthong; j velar fricative, not Slovak j.

selections.sense: a public green area for walking or resting
selections.levelRationale: Supplies a free outdoor alternative to paid entertainment.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Basic place, not industrial park or vehicle fleet.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; parques; ir al parque.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress par; qu represents k and u is silent.
uncertainties: S/T share this physical place; primary C ID retained without duplicating it.

selections.sense: a shore area of sand or stones beside the sea
selections.levelRationale: Identifies a familiar outdoor leisure destination.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Concrete beach rather than coastal processes or holiday services.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Feminine; playas; ir a la playa.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress pla; y consonant varies regionally, not a hiatus.
uncertainties: S owns geography reuse and T travel context; preserve one shore sense.

selections.sense: a live musical performance for an audience
selections.levelRationale: Names an event alternative to watching a film or visiting a museum.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Performance sense only, not agreement or orderly arrangement.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; conciertos; ir a un concierto.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress cier with ie diphthong; c before i theta in es-ES.

selections.sense: the activity of reading written text
selections.levelRationale: An abstract activity label extends the beginner's concrete leer un libro pattern.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 uses the verb and book; the nominal activity is proposed as an A2 extension.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Feminine; lectura de; plural lecturas can name reading assignments, outside this row.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress tu; retain ct cluster without extra vowel.
uncertainties: Existing A1 placement proposed A2; review literacy-classroom need before migration.

selections.sense: a picture made primarily with drawn lines
selections.levelRationale: Distinguishing drawn from painted works extends basic museum/object identification.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 foto and generic visual reference precede medium-specific product vocabulary.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; dibujos; not the verb form dibujo as a separate sense.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress bu; j velar fricative.
uncertainties: PCIC18.3 places this object distinction in A2; preserve legacy ID pending adjudication.

selections.sense: a two-wheeled pedal-powered vehicle
selections.levelRationale: A learner can identify their leisure equipment and transport object.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Naming the vehicle does not imply A1 mastery of cycling route or repair vocabulary.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Feminine; bicicletas; bici is a feminine colloquial shortened form.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress cle; four syllables, c before i theta in reference es-ES.
uncertainties: T shares transport-object ownership; same vehicle sense, not separate sports equipment ID.

selections.sense: a leisurely walk undertaken for enjoyment
selections.levelRationale: The leisure activity noun supports routine-plan descriptions after immediate destinations.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 names the park and simple walking mode; go-for-a-walk collocations are A2 in PCIC8.1.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; paseos; dar un paseo; promenade/place meaning separate.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Three syllables pa-se-o with final hiatus.
uncertainties: Existing A1 -> A2 proposal; do not merge promenade/place names.

selections.sense: produce music using an instrument
selections.levelRationale: Instrument-playing is a lexical verb sense needed after basic singing/listening choices.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 cantar/bailar/listen precede instrument-specific ability statements in PCIC18.2.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Regular -ar; tocar un instrumento with no a before instrument; toque spelling in later forms.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Final car stress; c is k; preserve final r.
uncertainties: Existing ID means playing an instrument, not physical contact. P must mint/link a separate contact sense if selected.

selections.sense: move the body rhythmically with music
selections.levelRationale: A concrete first-person activity verb supports a simple hobby answer.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Not metaphorical movement or a named professional dance technique.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Regular -ar; bailo/baila/bailamos; intransitive or with a dance type.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Final lar stress, ai diphthong in bai.

selections.sense: move through water using the body
selections.levelRationale: States an ordinary physical activity or elementary ability.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: The activity is independent of training techniques or competitive strokes.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Regular -ar; nado/nada; saber nadar uses F ability sense.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Final dar stress; keep intervocalic d audible enough for identification.

selections.sense: take part in a game or sport for amusement
selections.levelRationale: A beginner needs one participation verb for the selected game/sport choices.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Game participation, not gamble or play a social role.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Present juego/juegas/juega/juegan; jugamos/jugáis; jugar a/al in reference Spain usage.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Infinitive final gar; j fricative and ue in stressed present forms.
uncertainties: Regional omission of a with sport names should be labeled valid where appropriate.

selections.sense: providing amusement or entertainment
selections.levelRationale: Supplies a short personal reaction to an activity without an extended review.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Narrow entertaining quality; divertirse event narration is a separate construction.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Divertida/divertidos/divertidas; ser divertido for the quality.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress ti; four syllables, no added accent.
uncertainties: Independent early reaction-word proposal; not a blanket claim for all emotion adjectives.

selections.sense: a recent report of an event
selections.levelRationale: Distinguishing news content from the publication expands basic media identification.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 can name a newspaper; reporting and evaluating current events remain later.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Feminine; noticias; plural news does not create a separate sense.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress ti; cia diphthong; c before i theta in es-ES.
uncertainties: Legacy A1 proposed A2 as content-level extension beyond PCIC9.4 A1 publication objects.

selections.sense: a regularly issued newspaper
selections.levelRationale: A learner can name an everyday reading object or request it at a kiosk.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Publication sense, not adjective periodic.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; periódicos; leer el periódico.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress rió; ió diphthong; written accent retained in plural.

selections.sense: a magazine containing articles and images
selections.levelRationale: Completes the practical newspaper/magazine contrast for choosing reading material.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Not an inspection, military review or stage revue.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Feminine; revistas; revista de viajes as later topic modifier.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress vis; initial r is a trill.

selections.sense: a short communication sent from one person to another
selections.levelRationale: Names a small written item in an immediate digital or personal exchange.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: The basic message does not imply an abstract moral or implicit artistic message.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine; mensajes; mensaje electrónico is a transparent modifier.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress sa; j fricative; no silent final e.
uncertainties: PCIC9.2 supplies A1 written electronic-message context; call-message handling is later.

selections.sense: a written letter sent to another person
selections.levelRationale: Identifies personal written correspondence alongside a postcard or electronic message.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Correspondence only; the restaurant menu is a distinct H proposal.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Feminine; cartas; escribir una carta; no automatic playing-card meaning.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress car; maintain rt sequence.
uncertainties: Preserve es-sk:a1:245-carta for correspondence; H menu must not overwrite it.

selections.sense: the electronic system used to exchange written messages
selections.levelRationale: Names a familiar communication channel and supports choosing how to contact someone.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: System sense is not automatically an individual message or mailbox address.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Masculine mass phrase; electrónico agrees; email/e-mail variants require later editorial choice.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Correo has rr trill and e-o hiatus; electrónico stress tró.
uncertainties: P owns address identification as a separate phrase; individual correo message granularity remains explicit.

selections.sense: a telephone communication event
selections.levelRationale: Names a call as distinct from a written message in a minimal contact exchange.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Narrow call label before leaving messages, transferring calls or describing failed connections.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes say otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Feminine; llamadas; una llamada de/por teléfono.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Stress ma; initial ll with reference yeísmo and valid regional variants.
uncertainties: PCIC9.1/9.3 emphasize call operations at A2; propose early naming only for channel choice.

selections.sense: the display surface of an electronic device

exclusions.subject: An exhaustive list of hobbies, sports, games, art forms or works
exclusions.reason: This version bounds A1 to choosing among enumerated passive/creative/physical/social activities, recognizing their selected venues/roles and making a short preference statement. It is not a national sports list or cultural canon. Specialist genres/rules/technique and every possible leisure activity belong separately scoped later scenarios, subject to independent omission review.

exclusions.subject: Every spelling, gender form or metonym as an automatic extra catalog word
exclusions.reason: Actriz is an explicit actor counterpart, foto a fotografía shortening, and tele a televisión shortening. Radio/televisión medium versus device and cine/teatro venue versus discipline are explicit granularity proposals, not accepted net-new totals. Regional spellings or pronunciations need evidence and labeling, not duplicate inflation.

exclusions.subject: An unlimited inventory of keyboard symbols or platform-specific features
exclusions.reason: The selected identifier scenario covers ordinary letters/digits via shared foundations and the five symbols at-sign, dot, hyphen, underscore and forward slash. Complex URL query syntax, backslash/file paths, programming characters and specific commercial platforms are not the A1 contact task.

exclusions.subject: Bulk PCIC reproduction, art excerpts and implied institutional endorsement
exclusions.reason: Framework categories inform these original English editorial sense glosses and judgments. No protected learner definitions/examples, lyrics, literary passages or artwork are reproduced; no Cervantes certification or native-speaker approval is implied.

coverageNotes: Enumeration proposal for the declared A1-C scenarios: 16 selected objectives plus four later-scope dispositions and three unresolved prerequisites. No deferred-core selection gap is currently claimed closed by exclusion; independent coverage review can require additions and must mark required missing work deferred-core. Status remains proposed, not frozen or published.

All 55 primary legacy records in PCIC categories 8,9,18 are individually linked: 25 leisure, 15 media/communication, 15 arts. 55/55 exact primary IDs reconciled. Other baseline matches are cross-cell references or collision history, not extra primary records.

All 685 current records (500 legacy plus 185 supplemental) and all 138 exact next selections were inspected for relevant scope. C links the four relevant planned IDs a1-actions-planned-01 (escuchar), a1-actions-planned-02 (mirar, proposed A2), a2-routines-planned-03 (encender) and a2-routines-planned-05 (quedar). Shared numerals/questions/date/pragmatics remain explicit F/P/D prerequisites, not broadly cloned here.

Bounded scenarios: state activity/preference; identify a physical/social/creative activity and participant; choose a venue/event with shared time/price; distinguish broadcast medium/device/work/performer; identify a letter/postcard/message and its materials; identify telephone type and contact channel; recognize a newspaper/magazine/kiosk; reproduce a simple online identifier; identify a museum/exhibition/landmark/book/photograph. No claim of full speaking, listening or cultural competence follows from this vocabulary selection.

Primary identity guardrails: es-sk:a1:245-carta remains written correspondence, not H menu or playing card; es-sk:a1:236-tocar remains instrument-playing, not P physical contact; es-sk:a1:304-entrada remains event admission ticket, distinct from T physical entrance. Existing references on select-new meanings are collision history, not authorization to overwrite.

Additional granularity decisions: fotografía/foto is one image meaning with form variants; cámara equipment is separately proposed A2. Cine/teatro venue versus discipline, radio/televisión medium versus device, correo electrónico system versus countable message versus P mailbox address, ejercicio physical activity versus W practice task, pintura/cuadro and baile/danza remain explicitly unresolved. No new global IDs or compatibility migrations are created.

Recommended introduction is a sense/context judgment: several legacy A1 items receive explicit A2 proposals based on staged operational/genre/production demands. Early Wordfold scenario exceptions such as time-free label, piscina destination, llamada label or narrow phone action are individually flagged; PCIC framework columns are not asserted to certify these exact word levels.

Every row includes original rationale, form and written pronunciation risks. Later full Spanish descriptions/examples and Slovak hints, independent ES/SK reviews and actual es-ES physical-device/listening gates remain required. No learner text/runtime asset, saved progress, native build or remote service changed.
